title: Admissibility datum: an explicit hypothesis
statement:
Use the finite coefficient stage of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]: fix distinct primes $p_0,\ell$, an algebraic closure $k$ of a finite field of characteristic $p_0$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$ of its valuation ring, and $n\geq1$. Put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type $k$-schemes, with the meanings of finite type and separatedness in [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Fix a compactification $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}Y$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements].

For any scheme $T$, write $D_T=D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ for the ordinary unbounded derived category of sheaves of modules over the constant sheaf of rings $A_T$ on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Cohomology sheaves $\mathcal H^r$ have the meaning of [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves], and $Rp_*$ is the total derived direct image [def-weil-derived-direct-image]. Define $F=Rf_{!,n}=Rp_*j_!:D_X\to D_Y$ using the chosen compactification [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed].

Define the following conditions.

1. The *ambient exceptional right adjoint datum at $A$* is the condition that $\operatorname{FullCD}(p,A;c)$ [def-weil-full-cohomological-dimension] holds for the proper morphism $p:\overline X\to Y$, over the base $S=\operatorname{Spec}k$, for some integer $c\geq0$. That is, the cohomology sheaves $\mathcal H^r$ in degrees $r>c$ of the derived direct images of $p$, and of all its base changes $p_V:\overline X\times_YV\to V$ along objects $V\to Y$ of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, vanish on the pro-etale $A$-module sheaves exactly as quantified in that definition. The condition ranges over every pro-etale sheaf of $A$-modules, with no constructibility or etale-origin restriction, and imposes no finite-type condition on $V$.
2. Every right adjoint $G:D_Y\to D_X$ of $F$ carries $D^b_c(Y,A)$ into $D^b_c(X,A)$, and there are signed integers $c_f^-,c_f^+\in\mathbf Z$, independent of $a,b$, such that for every such $G$ and every $a\leq b$,
$$
 L\in D_c^{[a,b]}(Y,A)\ \Longrightarrow\ G(L)\in D_c^{[a+c_f^-,b+c_f^+]}(X,A).
$$
Here bounded constructibility and constructible cohomological intervals are those of [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, def-weil-constructible-intervals]. The displayed membership means bounded constructibility together with vanishing outside the indicated integer interval, also when that interval is empty. A right adjoint means natural bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_{D_Y}(F(K),L)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D_X}(K,G(L))$ for all $K\in D_X,L\in D_Y$.
3. Every right adjoint $G$ as in (2) carries $D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$ into $D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$, where $D^b_{ctf}$ is the full subcategory of bounded constructible complexes having finite Tor amplitude [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude].

Say that $f$, with its chosen compactification, is *exceptional-adjoint admissible at $A$*, or *carries the admissibility datum*, when (1), (2), and (3) all hold. The ambient datum names (1) alone; admissibility additionally requires (2) and (3). Neither condition is imposed as an automatic hypothesis on morphisms. This definition concerns the finite coefficient stage $A$, not a definition of an ambient right adjoint at integral or rational coefficients.

mathlib_searches.query: Exceptional inverse image of pro-etale sheaves has uniform bounded constructible cohomological amplitude and preserves finite Tor dimension
mathlib_searches.results: Returned sheafPullbackConstruction.preservesFiniteLimits and its instance, two sheafCongr inverse-map component lemmas, FormallyEtale tensor-product stability, module sheafification finite limits, IsEtale base-change stability, and sheafToPresheaf finite limits. None defines the full cohomological bound or exceptional-adjoint admissibility.
No hits for the cohomological-dimension name substring.

mathlib_searches.query: Define exceptional adjoint admissibility for a separated finite type scheme morphism: uniform cohomological dimension on all pro-etale sheaves and preservation of bounded constructible intervals and finite Tor amplitude by every right adjoint
mathlib_searches.results: Returned Scheme.Etale, Scheme.Modules.instIsRightAdjointPushforward, IsEtale, FormallyUnramified, IsFinite, Flat, LocallyQuasiFinite, and LocallyOfFinitePresentation. Read the candidate pushforward instance in Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/Sheaf.lean:189-199: it is the underived structure-sheaf pushforward being a right adjoint, not a right adjoint to exceptional direct image.

mathlib_searches.query: Uniform cohomological dimension of a proper map on all sheaves after base change, with right adjoint preserving constructibility and finite Tor amplitude
mathlib_searches.results: Returned two module-sheaf pushforward right-adjoint instances, sheafPushforwardCocontinuous, a continuous sheaf-pushforward right-adjoint instance, sheafAdjunctionCocontinuous, two coherent-topology sheaf-composition lemmas, and Condensed.lanSheafProfinite. Read Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Sheaf/PullbackContinuous.lean:160-163: the pushforward composition instance concerns underived module sheaves and asserts no exceptional-adjoint preservation conditions.

Logged grep in AlgebraicGeometry/Modules: Sheaf.lean:69,189,190,198,199 locate the sheafification and ordinary pullback/pushforward adjunctions. Read 189-199; these are not an exceptional right adjoint to derived compact support.

Logged grep in Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Sheaf/PullbackContinuous.lean: The raw single-file rg output was parsed as file/line fragments by the search wrapper; the displayed positions 100,133,163,174,181 concern ordinary module-sheaf pushforward and its composition. Read 160-163; no cohomological-dimension or constructibility assertion.

D_T now cites def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, the category used by every other cited node; def-pc-fibre-product dropped as unused.
